items.title: Ed Garland Interview, 1971-04-20
items.q: I played with him with the Black and Tanned Band in California.

ctx.x: I used to go out there and play with them kids here. Yeah. There was three of them. In fact, four of them. That fourth one, they couldn't do nothing with him. They tried to make a drummer out of him. They didn't want that. Mm-hmm. Mm-hmm. and then going out in California. We was working together. I played with him with the Black and Tanned Band in California. Ernest. You know all I know Ernest Johnson and when I come and found him here in California it was Kaiko. I don't know what a Kaiko.

Well that was Philip Kaiko was his brother. Cripple Pill. You remember Cripple Pill? I think he played banjo. No clarinet play. Yeah that was his brother and he was Kaiko. Yeah? Yeah. But I don't know and that's what Billy Moran's son, Lawrence Marrero used to call him Kaiko. Yeah. Did he ever play with Jelly Roll? Would you know? Who? Ernest Johnson. You wouldn't know maybe. Ernest was playing with the Black and Tanned. I don't think so now. Oh yeah. And what about Jelly Roll's band that he put up you know after…
